watch_count_predicate.description: Dynamic row predicate. Its nodes share the enclosing watch's 64-node, depth-8 success/failure budget. Unknown fields remain unknown under negation.

oneOf.description: One-hop observed relationship to a generation-fenced root. Direction is relative to that root: incoming selects rows pointing to it. Every root is checked even in empty populations or decisive boolean branches. Missing roots block evaluation; generation changes invalidate watches. Parallel edges count the candidate once. No transitive containment, complete-world relation absence, availability or completion claim.

condition.description: Count range [known matches, known matches plus unknowns] in the named entity-kind projection. Satisfaction requires every possible count to meet the comparison. Counts are records, not stack units, events, available resources or global absence proofs. Membership may change between samples.
